about: Machine-readable board index. Resolve a board name with 'aliases' (case, spaces, '-' and '_' ignored) to exactly one id, or ask the user when nothing or several match. Evidence levels come from dated lines in each profile's README (log); tools/validate_skills.py checks this file against the folders. A profile's 'renamed' map names templates verified under an earlier template name (shown with ' *'); tools/board_status.py writes the README level tables from this file.

evidence_levels.unverified: profile exists, nothing run on hardware
evidence_levels.flashed: programmed and verified on the board
evidence_levels.interactive: interactive tests passed: a person pressed buttons, the console gave the evidence
evidence_levels.observed: a person confirmed what the board showed (LED lit)

cubemx-freertos-stm32f303disco.note: FreeRTOS V10.0.1 from STM32CubeF3 (CMSIS-RTOS v2 wrapper, native API in the apps), HAL tick on TIM6; blink-rate flashed, LD3 rate stepping with B1 seen by the owner (2026-11-12); console SWO only, no automatic test
